movies.plot: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.
movies.tagline: Everything you've witched for.

movies.title: The Paradise
movies.plot: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

movies.title: Bernd - Operation Germanenkind
movies.plot: An in-depth look at how fascism hides behind facades of a tolerant, intellectual and open-minded society.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.plot: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
movies.tagline: See how far it goes.

movies.title: Lovebox
movies.plot: A society without money or competition: AfrikaBurn, the largest regional event inspired by the world-famous Burning Man, becomes the setting for a unique experiment. In the middle of the South African desert, an eclectic group of friends sets up their LOVEBOX spaceship, inviting visitors on a journey to the stars — and into themselves. Inside the LOVEBOX, two strangers meet for a few minutes and explore a question about love. Their encounters give rise to unexpected moments of connection and self-discovery. When the dust of the festival settles, the friends set out to bring the magic of the LOVEBOX into everyday life. But can the openness and sense of connection they experienced at AfrikaBurn survive beyond its temporary utopia?

movies.title: Ein Nobody gegen Putin
movies.plot: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
movies.tagline: The incredible story of an ordinary Russian teacher who exposed Putin's propaganda machine.

movies.title: Hirten
movies.plot: A young Montreal advertising executive, converted to a Provençal shepherd, has various misadventures with a civil servant who has cavalierly quit her job.

movies.title: Heart of Light - eleven songs for Fiji
movies.criticTitle: Heart of Light - eleven songs for Fiji
sourceTitles: Heart of Light - eleven songs for Fiji
Heart of Light - Eleven Songs for Fiji
movies.originalTitle: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
movies.plot: After decades abroad, Iona returns to her childhood home on Fiji, sensing that there she might find the answers to many questions she has about civilisation and its discontent.
movies.tmdbTitle: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji

If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?
movies.tagline: Turn back.

movies.title: The Uprising - Für die Freiheit
movies.plot: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.
movies.tagline: Rise or die.

movies.title: Spa Weekend
movies.plot: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.
movies.tagline: Friendship is a real trip.

movies.title: A Sad and Beautiful World
movies.plot: In this sweeping love story that spans three decades of passion, heartbreak, and hope, Nino and Yasmina find themselves drawn together by a magnetic relationship. As they face an impossible choice between love and survival, they must decide if they want to build a family and chart a path to happiness in Lebanon, despite the tragedies ravaging the country.

movies.title: A Poet
movies.plot: An aging poet finds purpose mentoring Yurlady, a talented teen, though exposing her to the poetry scene might be unwise. His own poetic pursuits led nowhere, leaving him a stereotypical obscure writer.

movies.title: The Beauty of Ballroom
movies.plot: If the world doesn’t accept you and your kind, trailblaze a world that does. Inspired by the Black and Latinx underground Ballroom culture of New York, Sun, Teddy, and Xyza create Ballroom communities in Southeast Asia as safe havens from homophobia, transphobia, color discrimination and HIV stigma.

movies.title: Meeting the Buddha
movies.plot: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

movies.title: Finding Emily

movies.plot: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.
movies.tagline: Right name, wrong number.

movies.title: Diamanti
movies.plot: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.

movies.title: Der Teufel möglicherweise
movies.plot: Charles drifts through politics, religion and psychoanalysis, rejecting them all. Once he realises the depth of his disgust with the moral and physical decline of the society he lives in, he decides that suicide is the only option...

movies.title: Meesaya Murukku 2
movies.plot: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

movies.title: Dear You
movies.plot: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.
movies.tagline: Every letter leads home.

movies.title: Hanuman Ansh
movies.plot: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.
movies.tagline: Jinke kaam mein seva, jinke bhav mein bhakti, aur jinke hriday mein Sita Ram.

movies.title: Sigma
movies.plot: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

movies.title: Üç Harfliler: Mühür
movies.plot: Fortune-teller Müzeyyen, a mansion filled with secrets and the darkness into which Fatma and her family are drawn...

movies.title: Moscas - Fliegen und andere Gäste
movies.plot: Olga lives a strictly regulated life without attachments in a vast apartment block. When out of financial necessity she rents a room in her apartment to a man who also sneaks-in his nine-year-old son, an unlikely bond forms. Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.

movies.title: The Stories
movies.plot: The Stories is a decades-spanning Egyptian family saga and love story set between the late 1960s and 1980s. The film follows Ahmed, a young man from a Middle-Class Cairo family who dreams of becoming a concert pianist. During the tense summer of 1967, as war looms over Egypt, he begins a pen-pal correspondence with an Austrian woman named Elizabeth (“Liz”). A semi-autobiographical film based on the director's parents and how they met.

movies.title: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
movies.criticTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
sourceTitles: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
movies.originalTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
movies.plot: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.
movies.tmdbTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
movies.tagline: Billie Eilish and James Cameron reinvent the concert experience.

movies.title: Shin Godzilla
movies.plot: When a massive, gilled monster emerges from the deep and tears through the city, the government scrambles to save its citizens.  A rag-tag team of volunteers cuts through a web of red tape to uncover the monster's weakness and its mysterious ties to a foreign superpower.  But time is not on their side - the greatest catastrophe to ever befall the world is about to evolve right before their very eyes.
movies.tagline: A god incarnate. A city doomed.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.plot: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.
movies.tagline: Evil found a way out.

movies.title: That's Why the Lady Is a Champ
movies.criticTitle: That's Why the Lady Is a Champ
sourceTitles: That's Why the Lady Is a Champ
That's Why The Lady Is A Champ
movies.plot: Christy Martin never imagined life beyond her small-town roots in West Virginia—until she discovered a knack for punching people. Fueled by grit, raw determination, and an unshakable desire to win, she charges into the world of boxing under the guidance of her trainer and manager-turned-husband, Jim. But while Christy flaunts a fiery persona in the ring, her toughest battles unfold outside it—confronting family, identity, and a relationship that just might become life-or-death.
movies.tagline: What does it take to become a legend?

movies.title: Onslaught
movies.plot: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.
movies.tagline: They unleashed their deadliest weapon on us.

movies.title: Lancelot, Ritter der Königin
movies.plot: Having failed in their quest for the Holy Grail, the knights of the Round Table return to Camelot, their number reduced to a mere handful. Seeing a rift developing between Lancelot and Mordred, Arthur urges his knights to bury their differences and become friends. However, the King is unaware that Lancelot is having an affair with his queen, Guinevere. Lancelot is torn between his duty to his king and his love for the queen, whilst Mordred is determined to use his infidelity to destroy him.

movies.title: Der Jazzsänger
movies.plot: A young Jewish man is torn between tradition and individuality when his old-fashioned family objects to his career as a jazz singer. This is the first full length feature film to use synchronized sound, and is the original film musical.
movies.tagline: Hear him sing Mammy, Toot Toot Tootsie, My Gal Sal, Mother I Still Have You.

movies.title: Der perfekte Schein - Der Fall Bojarski
movies.criticTitle: Der perfekte Schein - Der Fall Bojarski
sourceTitles: Der perfekte Schein - Der Fall Bojarski
movies.plot: A Polish engineer relocates to France and becomes a legendary counterfeiter. Working solo, he crafts flawless fake francs worth millions over 14 years, earning the nickname "Cézanne of counterfeit money" for his artistic skill and output.

movies.title: Chopin - Eine Sonate in Paris
movies.plot: He is the talk of the town, the most romantic figure of decadent Parisian nights. When his lungs start bleeding, Chopin knows his days are numbered. Composing becomes his only obsession. The ticking clock rushes him to revolutionize music.

movies.title: Dangerous Minds - Wilde Gedanken
movies.plot: Former Marine Louanne Johnson lands a gig teaching in a pilot program for bright but underachieving teens at a notorious inner-city high school. After having a terrible first day, she decides she must throw decorum to the wind. When Johnson returns to the classroom, she does so armed with a no-nonsense attitude informed by her military training and a fearless determination to better the lives of her students -- no matter what the cost.
movies.tagline: She broke the rules... and changed their lives.

movies.title: Don't Trouble The Trouble
movies.plot: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

movies.title: Forgotten Island
movies.plot: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.
movies.tagline: No memory left behind.

movies.title: Runner
movies.plot: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.
movies.tagline: Next-day delivery isn't an option.

movies.title: Der Himmel über Berlin
movies.plot: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds — with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk — that it might be possible for him to take human form.
movies.tagline: There are angels on the streets of Berlin.

movies.title: Boulevard der Dämmerung
movies.plot: A hack screenwriter writes a screenplay for a former silent film star who has faded into Hollywood obscurity.
movies.tagline: A Hollywood Story: Sensational...Daring...Unforgettable...Sunset Blvd

movies.title: Yanuni
movies.plot: Indigenous chief Juma Xipaia fights to protect tribal lands despite assassination attempts. Her struggle intensifies after learning she's pregnant, while her husband, Special Forces ranger Hugo Loss, stands by her side.
movies.tagline: We are the forest.

movies.title: An Unfinished Film
movies.altTitle: Yi bu wei wancheng de dianying
movies.plot: A film crew gathers in a hotel near Wuhan to resume production of a film that was interrupted ten years earlier, but an unexpected event once again disrupts the preparations.

movies.title: Lethal Weapon 4
sourceTitles: Lethal Weapon 4 - Zwei Profis räumen auf
movies.plot: With personal crises and age weighing in on them, LAPD officers Riggs and Murtaugh must contend with a deadly Chinese crime lord trying to get his brother out of prison.
movies.tagline: The gang's all here.

movies.title: Eine Krankheit wie ein Gedicht
movies.plot: Jelena Ilić's father suffers from drug-induced psychosis and has been in forensic psychiatry for five years. Now the day of his release is approaching. How can the director be sure that her father will not relapse and become violent again? How can a reconciliation be achieved? And how can society successfully reintegrate a mentally ill offender?

movies.title: Lügen über meine Mutter
movies.plot: In the 1980s, the life of a family in a small village is determined by just one issue: the mother's body weight. Her husband Werner decides that she needs to lose weight, Cornelia suffers as a result and their daughter Ela is caught in the middle.

movies.title: Die vergessene Insel
movies.plot: 1908: Pascali, a spy for the Sultan, sends reports to Istanbul that nobody reads. His suspicions are roused when a British archaeologist appears, who may not be quite what he seems.
movies.tagline: At the end of an empire, a mystery began.

movies.title: OASIS: Don't Look Back In Anger
sourceTitles: OASIS: Don't Look Back In Anger
Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movies.originalTitle: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movies.plot: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.
movies.tmdbTitle: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movies.tagline: The great wait is over.

movies.title: Casablanca
movies.plot: In Casablanca, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.
movies.tagline: They had a date with fate in Casablanca!

movies.title: Bitteres Fest
movies.plot: Elsa is an advertising director whose mother dies during a long December holiday. She works non-stop and, without realizing, doesn’t give herself time to mourn her mother’s absence. After a crisis, Elsa decides to travel to the island of Lanzarote accompanied by her friend Patricia, who also needs to get away from the city. The story of these characters runs parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.
movies.tagline: You’re confusing fiction with reality.

movies.title: Etwas ganz Besonderes
movies.plot: As a contestant in a singing casting show, Lea is asked by the TV team who she is and what makes her special. She doesn't know and begins to slip into different roles in her search for what makes her special, developing an unexpected fascination for her aunt Kati. Kati's return home as head architect for the renovation of the Residenzschloss after many years abroad reunites the family in one place. This reunion raises the hopes of grandparents Friedrich and Christel that they can join forces to give their pension, which has few visitors, a new lease of life.

movies.title: Watching People Watching Birds
movies.plot: Highly topical, serious and humorous, this film observes people who are passionately devoted to bird watching. Through their eyes and ears, we discover the world of the birds that becomes a metaphor for the state of the world.

movies.title: Der Astronaut - Project Hail Mary
movies.plot: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.
movies.tagline: Believe in the Hail Mary.

movies.title: Double Feature: Chronicles of Afro-Beats + Cock Crown at Dawn
sourceTitles: Double Feature: Chronicles of Afro-Beats + Cock Crown at Dawn

movies.title: West Indies: The Fugitive Slaves of Liberty
sourceTitles: West Indies: The Fugitive Slaves of Liberty
movies.originalTitle: West Indies ou les Nègres marrons de la liberté
movies.plot: Aboard a giant slave ship in an abandoned Citroën factory, the history of the West Indies is traced through several centuries of French oppression. The ship becomes a stage for the people to tell stories via song and dance—from their enslavement to their displacement in Metropolitan France.
movies.tmdbTitle: West Indies: The Fugitive Slaves of Liberty

movies.title: All my Sisters
movies.plot: Growing up in Tehran, a capital of the 21st century... From 2007 to 2025, within a loving family, eighteen years in the life of three sisters, from their early childhood to their daily lives as young women in search of freedom. Brought up in the traditional way, witnessing the struggles of a youth in perpetual movement, what is their future in today's Iranian society?

movies.title: Für immer 16
movies.plot: Charlotte, Helena, and Oskar haven't really been in touch since their experimental filmmaking group disbanded. A shared vacation aims to reunite the bitterly estranged trio, but envy and jealousy soon flare up again. Things get really complicated when Rudolph joins the group and they decide to make a film about a female serial killer.

movies.title: Hard Boiled
movies.plot: A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.
movies.tagline: As a cop, he has brains, brawn, and an instinct to kill.

movies.title: Ice Cream Man
movies.plot: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.
movies.tagline: We all scream.

movies.title: Lebensansichten eines Huhns
movies.plot: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.

movies.title: Spaziergang nach Syrakus
movies.plot: In the middle of his life, Paul Gompitz from Rostock makes the decision to travel to Syracuse in Sicily. He is driven to follow in the footsteps of the poet Johann Gottlieb Seume. But: Paul lives in the GDR, behind the most annoying border in the world. His plan is impossible by legal means. So he has to prepare an escape.

movies.title: The Love That Remains
movies.plot: Anna and Magnús are separating, working out how best to navigate breaking up without confusing their three children. Over the course of one year, life continues, in many ways, as normal, with each change of season occasioning little differences at home and in the surrounding landscape.

movies.title: We Are here: February Answers, Enigma de S., The Map my Feet are on
sourceTitles: We Are here: February Answers, Enigma de S., The Map my Feet are on

movies.title: We are here: Films in Film
sourceTitles: We are here: Films in Film

movies.title: Blue Velvet
movies.plot: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.
movies.tagline: It's a strange world, isn't it?

movies.title: Das Geld
movies.plot: A forged 500-franc note is passed from person to person and shop to shop, until it falls into the hands of a genuine innocent who doesn't see it for what it is—which will have devastating consequences on his life.

movies.title: Das Hohelied der Liebe
movies.plot: A well-off young woman decides to become a nun, joining a convent that rehabilitates female prisoners. Through their program, she meets a woman named Thérèse who refuses any help because she says she was innocent of the crime she was convicted for. After being released from prison, Thérèse murders the actual perpetrator of the crime and comes to seek sanctuary in the convent.

movies.title: Der Prozeß der Jeanne d'Arc
movies.plot: Rouen, Normandy, 1431, during the Hundred Years' War. After being captured by French soldiers from an opposing faction, Joan of Arc, the Maid of Orléans, is unjustly tried by an ecclesiastical court overseen by her English enemies.
movies.tmdbTitle: The Trial of Joan of Arc

movies.title: Die Abenteuer des Prinzen Achmed
movies.plot: Taken from The Arabian Nights, a wicked sorcerer and the beautiful prince Achmed battle one against the other during a series of wondrous adventures.

movies.title: Die Damen vom Bois de Boulogne
movies.criticTitle: Die Damen vom Bois de Boulogne
sourceTitles: Die Damen vom Bois de Boulogne
movies.originalTitle: Les Dames du bois de Boulogne
movies.plot: A love story that follows the maneuverings of a society lady as she connives to initiate a scandalous affair between her aristocratic ex-lover and a prostitute.
movies.tmdbTitle: Les Dames du bois de Boulogne

movies.title: Die Farbe des Granatapfels
movies.plot: The life of the revered 18th-century Armenian poet and musician Sayat-Nova. Portraying events in the life of the artist from childhood up to his death, the movie addresses in particular his relationships with women, including his muse. The production tells Sayat-Nova's dramatic story by using both his poems and largely still camerawork, creating a work hailed as revolutionary by Mikhail Vartanov.
movies.tagline: A poetic evocation of the life of Armenian poet Sayat Nova.

movies.title: Die Sanfte
movies.plot: A woman lives in a small village in Russia. One day she receives the parcel she sent to her husband, serving a sentence in prison. Confused and angered, she sets out to find why her package was returned to sender.

movies.title: Double Feature: Vartinis + Ziyaret - Die Stimme der Natur
sourceTitles: Double Feature: Vartinis + Ziyaret - Die Stimme der Natur

movies.title: Ein zum Tode Verurteilter ist entflohen
movies.criticTitle: Ein zum Tode Verurteilter ist entflohen
sourceTitles: Ein zum Tode Verurteilter ist entflohen
movies.originalTitle: Un condamné à mort s'est échappé
movies.plot: A captured French Resistance fighter during World War II engineers a daunting escape from prison.
movies.tagline: Robert Bresson's Prize Winning Film

movies.title: Ghost in the Shell
movies.originalTitle: GHOST IN THE SHELL / 攻殻機動隊
movies.plot: In the year 2029, the barriers of our world have been broken down by the net and by cybernetics, but this brings new vulnerability to humans in the form of brain-hacking. When a highly-wanted hacker known as 'The Puppetmaster' begins involving them in politics, Section 9, a group of cybernetically enhanced cops, are called in to investigate and stop the Puppetmaster.
movies.tagline: It found a voice... now it needs a body.

movies.title: Hamlet
movies.plot: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, returns home to find his father murdered and his mother now marrying the murderer... his uncle. Meanwhile, war is brewing.
movies.tagline: Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.

movies.title: Herbstfeuer
movies.plot: A passionate hotel manager is obsessed with a clairvoyant's claim that he is to blame for the unexplained fire at his legendary grand hotel. To free himself from this burden, he teams up with an astute detective inspector to expose a former employee as the arsonist. This unexpectedly puts him at the centre of the investigation – and he must face the truth.
movies.tagline: Truth cannot be thrown into the fire — it is the fire. F. Dürrenmatt

movies.title: Lost Highway
movies.plot: A tormented jazz musician finds himself lost in an enigmatic story involving murder, surveillance, gangsters, doppelgängers, and an impossible transformation inside a prison cell.
movies.tagline: A lost road on the edge of strange...

movies.title: Metropolis
movies.plot: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the rich and the poor, the son of the city's mastermind meets a prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences.
movies.tagline: There can be no understanding between the hands and the brain unless the heart acts as mediator.

movies.title: Mouchette
movies.plot: A young girl living in the French countryside suffers constant indignities at the hand of alcoholism and her fellow man.

movies.title: Mulholland Drive - Straße der Finsternis
movies.plot: Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.
movies.tagline: An actress longing to be a star. A woman searching for herself. Both worlds will collide... on Mulholland Drive.

movies.title: My Uncle Jens
movies.plot: Akam, a young literature teacher, lives a comfortable life in Oslo until his estranged uncle from the Iranian part of Kurdistan comes for a surprise visit. Despite limited space in his shared flat with friends, Akam feels obligated to invite his uncle to stay for a few days. However, his uncle quickly makes himself at home and shows no sign of leaving anytime soon. Torn between his sense of familial duty and growing tension in the flat, Akam begins to suspect there's more to his uncle's visit than just a casual trip. What follows is a series of revelations and unexpected events that could have life changing consequences for them both.
movies.tagline: A comically chaotic example of family reunification

movies.title: Nosferatu - Eine Symphonie des Grauens
movies.plot: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.
movies.tagline: Succumb to the darkness.

movies.title: Pickpocket
movies.plot: Michel takes up pickpocketing on a lark and is arrested soon after. His mother dies shortly after his release, and despite the objections of his only friend, Jacques, and his mother's neighbor Jeanne, Michel teams up with a couple of petty thieves in order to improve his craft. With a police inspector keeping an eye on him, Michel also tries to get a straight job, but the temptation to steal is hard to resist.
movies.tagline: To reach you at last, what a strange path I had to take.

movies.title: Sideways
movies.plot: Two middle-aged men embark on a spiritual journey through Californian wine country. One is an unpublished novelist suffering from depression, and the other is only days away from walking down the aisle.
movies.tagline: In search of wine. In search of women. In search of themselves.

movies.title: Sound Of Metal
movies.plot: Metal drummer Ruben begins to lose his hearing. When a doctor tells him his condition will worsen, he thinks his career and life is over. His girlfriend Lou checks the former addict into a rehab for the deaf hoping it will prevent a relapse and help him adapt to his new life. After being welcomed and accepted just as he is, Ruben must choose between his new normal and the life he once knew.
movies.tagline: Music was his world. Then silence revealed a new one.

movies.title: Tagebuch eines Landpfarrers
movies.plot: An inexperienced, sickly priest shows up in the rural French community of Ambricourt, where he joins the community's clergy. But the locals don't take kindly to the priest, and his ascetic ways and unsociable demeanor make him an outcast. During Bible studies at the nearby girls school, he is continually mocked by his students. Then his attempt to intervene in a family feud backfires into a scandal. His failures, compounded with his declining health, begin to erode his faith.
movies.tagline: A priest of humble origin, lost in the maze of worldiness

movies.title: Twin Peaks - Der Film
movies.originalTitle: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
movies.plot: In the questionable town of Deer Meadow, Washington, FBI Agent Desmond inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the more cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate.
movies.tmdbTitle: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
movies.tagline: In a town like Twin Peaks, no one is innocent.

movies.title: Vier Nächte eines Träumers
movies.plot: Jacques, a young man with artistic aspirations, spends four nights wandering Paris with a young woman, whom he rescued from suicide.

movies.title: Zum Beispiel Balthasar
movies.plot: The story of a donkey Balthazar as he is passed from owner to owner, some kind and some cruel but all with motivations beyond his understanding. Balthazar, whose life parallels that of his first keeper, Marie, is truly a beast of burden, suffering the sins of humankind. But despite his powerlessness, he accepts his fate nobly.

movies.title: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
movies.criticTitle: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
sourceTitles: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
movies.plot: Francesca Albanese, the UN Special Rapporteur on human rights in the occupied Palestinian territories, had already labelled events in Gaza a genocide back in March 2024. Following her lead, this piece takes us deep into the heart of the institution’s crisis, as it struggles with its inability to stop the massacre of civilians.

movies.title: Hass - La Haine
movies.plot: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.
movies.tagline: How far you fall doesn't matter, it's how you land…

movies.title: Konfliktrohstoffe und globale Verantwortung - Coltanabbau im Osten der DR Kongo
sourceTitles: Konfliktrohstoffe und globale Verantwortung - Coltanabbau im Osten der DR Kongo

movies.title: Las hijas del fuego - Die feurigen Schwestern
movies.criticTitle: Las hijas del fuego - Die feurigen Schwestern
sourceTitles: Las hijas del fuego - Die feurigen Schwestern
movies.plot: Three women meet by chance at the end of the world, in Argentinian Patagonia, and set out on a polyamorous journey, caught up in the search for new kinds of relationships, far from possession and pain. They become the Daughters of Fire, a band dedicated to helping those women who look for their own path to erotica.

movies.plot: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.
movies.tagline: Visuals Can Be Deceptive

movies.title: Naza
movies.plot: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

movies.title: Mond
movies.plot: Sarah, a former professional kickboxer from Vienna, accepts an offer to work as a personal trainer for a rich family in the Middle East. She finds herself in a foreign world, in a palace behind walls and cut off from the internet, where the sisters are under surveillance around the clock. They have no interest in learning to box. So why has Sarah been brought here?

movies.title: Yi Yi
movies.plot: Each member of a family in Taipei asks hard questions about life's meaning as they live through everyday quandaries. NJ is morose: his brother owes him money, his mother is in a coma, his wife suffers a spiritual crisis when she finds her life a blank and his business partners make bad decisions.
movies.tagline: We never live the same day twice.

movies.title: Albrecht Weinberg - Es ist immer in meinem Kopf
sourceTitles: Albrecht Weinberg - Es ist immer in meinem Kopf

movies.title: Io vivo qui
movies.plot: "Yo vivo aquì" is the story of four South American communities between Ecuador and Colombia that have changed their lifestyle to realize their dream of protecting nature. These are families who have chosen to live in harmony with nature, adopting sustainable agricultural practices, renewable energy, and responsible consumption models. Through interviews and moments of everyday life, the documentary offers an inspiring look at the choices and efforts these communities are making to preserve the planet and create a better future.

movies.title: Rip
movies.plot: A young girl goes missing in the wild surf of a small coastal town. The effects of this are far-reaching for her family & community. Set in an unforgiving landscape, this story explores feelings of loss & it's consequences.  This short film is entirely composed of still photographs, animated together to create movement & to portray the mind's recollection of memories, creating a surreal experience.
movies.tagline: A photo captures a memory, even the ones you'd rather forget.

movies.title: Rockers don't stop: The Revival of Rockers Revenge
sourceTitles: Rockers don't stop: The Revival of Rockers Revenge
movies.originalTitle: Rockers Don't Stop: The Revival of Rockers Revenge
movies.plot: A comeback story with grit and groove. New York's 1980's Dance pioneers Rockers Revenge reunite decades later to finally record their debut album, transforming nostalgia into a powerful journey of friendship, resilience, and unfinished dreams. From the frontlines of New York’s COVID crisis to the pulse of Black Lives Matter, their music channels loss, hope, and defiance. Directed by legendary DJ and music producer Arthur Baker – whose collaborations with New Order, Afrika Bambaataa, Bruce Springsteen and Al Green defined an era – this film spans 30 years yet feels urgently of the moment - a testament to survival, second chances, and the unstoppable spirit of Rockers Revenge.
movies.tmdbTitle: Rockers Don't Stop: The Revival of Rockers Revenge

movies.title: Beware Boiúna
movies.plot: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.
movies.tagline: Witness terror on a gigantic scale.

movies.title: B-Movie: Lust & Sound in West-Berlin 1979-1989
movies.plot: The wild West Berlin of the 1980s became the creative melting pot of pop subcultures: music, art and chaos. Before the Iron Curtain fell, anything and everything seemed possible.
movies.tagline: If you can remember the 80's, you weren't there!

movies.title: You already know
movies.plot: New Orleans is the party city, the musical mecca bursting with feel-good rhythms that run deep in your veins, but there's one infectious beat, one party that's been rocking the city for 25 years, and it's called Bounce.  You ALready Know is the story of Bounce music, diving into its rich history from the late 80s until now. A soul-stirring New Orleanian narrative, told through the eyes of youth worker and King of Bounce, DJ Jubilee.
movies.tagline: A New Orleans Movie to feed your soul, free your mind and shake dat booty.

movies.title: Ghost School
movies.plot: Carola is a mischievous girl who doesn't care much for school- except for sports and recess, of course. Without her good friend Willi to keep her on the straight and narrow, she would really be in trouble. One day at school, Carola has an idea. She invents what she calls "International Ghosts' Day" and a ghost named "Buh" to go with it. When Buh turns out to be less-than-imaginary the two decide to switch places, with Buh taking on all the schoolwork, and Carola taking the opportunity to play practical jokes on all her friends...

movies.title: Jack Johnson: Surfilmusic
movies.plot: This intimate documentary traces Johnson's evolution from surfer to filmmaker to world-renowned musician. Rare archives and present-day reflections reveal how lived experience, friendship, & exploration shaped the sound & stories behind the music.
